---
applyTo: "education/**,guides/**,docs/**,prompts/**"
---

# Education, guides and documentation instructions

- Customer-neutral and synthetic only.
  - Never include customer names, abbreviations, people, document titles, URLs or
    identifiers.
  - Use-Case Guides are sanitized re-expressions written in our own words.
- Every capability and pattern covers Executive, L100, L200, L300 and L400.
- Labs follow LEARN → SEE → BUILD → INSPECT → BREAK IT → RECOVER → VERIFY → GO DEEPER → TRY WITH
  COPILOT → TRY WITH CLAUDE CODE → PRODUCTION NOTES.
- Label status clearly as GA, PREVIEW, DEPRECATED or UNKNOWN/NEEDS VALIDATION, and cite
  `docs/research/sources.yaml` entries.
- Clearly separate SIMULATED LOCALLY, DOCUMENTED BEHAVIOR, REQUIRES TENANT VALIDATION,
  ASSUMPTION and PRODUCTION RECOMMENDATION.
- No clinical recommendations. Label demonstration metrics as synthetic.
